name: its_stare
for: Fog Horror (The Horror in the Hollow): its stare
notes: A rolling crescent bank of its violet-ash fog 91 px tall (lit, ragged smoke texture flowing back) on a ground-fog tongue, black tendrils whipping back off it, and lilac eye-slits with dark slit pupils opening and closing across its face. Chest-high: roll through it. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 96; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 73; place that point on the ring's position.
